rebrew.schema.json is the dispatch contract shared with ai.relumea.app.backend-go,
which mirrors it byte-identically at contracts/dispatch/rebrew.schema.json
(generated there with `go run ./cmd/surface-tracker`). The metadata operations
(rebrew.metadata_describe, rebrew.metadata_diff, rebrew.metadata_carry, the
version 3 capture descriptor, the apply_candidate metadata and
attested_registry_digest fields), rebrew.project_targets, rebrew.vocabulary
(with placeholder_name), rebrew.check_cflags and rebrew.rename_identifier
were extended here first, and rebrew.coverage_export, rebrew.source_variants,
rebrew.decompme_export, rebrew.source_rename, rebrew.source_split and
rebrew.source_merge were removed here first (no caller; their source work is
rebrew.retained_source_operation); the rest is the copy of backend commit
80314a46a1ae26d9ef3d56d90e1d454c561f5928.
SHA-256: afa2a892c584929eeef860ef5dced2a826e2008236edc1c549ee585384c343c9.
tests/test_ops.py validates every op request and reply against it.
